threat_event: A tenant-added tag on any tenant's checkout skims card data
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Tags allowed in the payment step; 641 client tenants have checkout tags
treatment_plan: Block tags in checkout; inventory and tamper detection for every tenant

threat_event: Malicious code enters the platform through the build pipeline
existing_controls: Signed commits; dependency scanning; signed images
treatment_plan: Software bill of materials for every release

threat_event: The pricing module breaks client price caps or accessible seating rules in client tenants
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Client settings vary; no parity safeguard in the product
treatment_plan: Product safeguard that excludes accessible levels by default

threat_event: Client notices are late because terms differ by contract
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: 186 clients with 24-hour terms; 72 hours standard; no register in support tooling
treatment_plan: Client notice register; templates; tabletop

threat_event: Ransomware or destructive attack on TVOP production
existing_controls: Immutable backups; provider B disaster recovery
treatment_plan: Quarterly restore tests of every database

threat_event: A client administrator account without MFA is taken over
treatment_plan: Require MFA for client administrators by 2027-01-31

threat_event: A support engineer opens client tenants without a reason
treatment_plan: Ticket-linked just-in-time access

threat_event: Client purchaser data is used for pricing model training without contract permission
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Feed covers all tenants; 212 pre-2024 agreements
treatment_plan: Filter by contract; amend at renewal

threat_event: Credential stuffing takes over patron and subscriber accounts
existing_controls: Breached-password screening; bot detection on sign-in
treatment_plan: Passkeys; step-up on account changes

threat_event: Token vault keys are compromised
treatment_plan: Annual key ceremony review by the QSA

threat_event: The bot challenge blocks screen-reader users and patrons on mobile networks
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Visual challenge only for some tenants; network signal bias
existing_controls: Box office and phone channels open during on-sales
treatment_plan: Accessible challenge default; per-access-type measurement (P10)

threat_event: Platform capacity fails during a record on-sale
treatment_plan: Load test before every top-tier on-sale

threat_event: The generative support assistant reveals patron data or gives wrong refund answers
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Assistant can look up orders after sign-in
existing_controls: Order lookup only after sign-in; refunds by humans
treatment_plan: Monthly answer sampling (P10)

threat_event: A script vendor (tag manager or analytics) is compromised and serves malicious code on checkout
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Vendor code trusted by the content security policy; vendors never assessed
treatment_plan: Remove vendor code from the payment step; vendor assessments; tamper detection

threat_event: An offshore contractor's access creates a restricted data transaction
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Testing contractor staff in the United States and India
existing_controls: Contract bars access from countries of concern; synthetic test data
treatment_plan: Annual due diligence attestation

threat_event: The CCPA cybersecurity audit is not ready for its first report
treatment_plan: Audit plan aligned with P07 by 2027-06-30

threat_event: Fraud scoring drift lets card-testing attacks through
treatment_plan: Monthly model monitoring

threat_event: The SOC 2 report carries exceptions for payment page controls
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Script controls cover platform scripts only
treatment_plan: Close POAM-006 to POAM-009 within the 2026-2027 period

threat_event: A client's leaked API key exposes its order data
treatment_plan: Key expiry and secret scanning alerts to clients

threat_event: An engineer misuses production access
treatment_plan: Accepted by the Ticketing and Streaming security and compliance lead (Low)
owner: Ticketing and Streaming security and compliance lead
